tool_args.rationale: Rows show y equals x_now when u_now=u_past, and otherwise the residual y-x_now follows the sign of the step and declines in magnitude with H. Fit amplitude and decay time numerically for x_now + A (u_now-u_past) exp(-H/tau); no additional measurement appears necessary for the stated horizon.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Observed zero-step row gives y=x_now exactly, while the four nonzero-step rows are consistently explained by a single exponentially decaying signed step term; the present data identify the compact two-parameter law adequately.
The symmetric zero-step observation y=x_now and signed response to u_now-u_past are not explained by a mean-reverting law of x alone.
It captures the signed step dependence but misses the observed x_now baseline at zero step; a baseline plus decaying step term is needed.
It does not resolve the temporal mechanism and is explicitly irrelevant to the observed structure.
